batch1.blow_plus_magic: Carried on the blow (the real hit lands and the technique rides inside it; both damages written)
batch1.explanation_placement: In narration, as law (stated plainly and moved on; trained POVs and speakers may still give the physics where they have earned it)
batch1.clashes: By the real physics (natural result of the two phenomena, e.g. fire meets frost: steam and scald)
batch1.technique_count: As many as it needs (no fixed number)

batch2.utility_magic: All four: active defence; movement techniques; sensing and reading; recovery and healing
batch2.weirdness: By the character (a tinkerer finds bizarre tricks, a brute finds brute ones; the card decides)
batch2.stage_gap: Mix, scaled to the gap (one Stage hard but fair; two takes a vow or breakthrough; three or more the room shows it and the fight ends like a rope)
batch2.info_war: Central (fighters scout, bluff, lie about techniques, hide cards; the reveal can win or lose the fight)

batch3.combos: Drilled pairs, shown on the page (Resonant Pairs and Synergia; one sets, one finishes)
batch3.weapons: Weapon as an extension of the art (carries part of the technique and the user's body; no personality)
batch3.aura_in_motion: A constant visible coat (colour clings, surges at contact, draws back toward the core as reserve falls)
batch3.pc_techniques: Veteran inventive (new uses inside the card's cost and limit; his PC kit used like a lived-in man)
